Technology.label: TECHNOLOGY
Technology.title: How does ventilation work without electricity?
Technology.intro: Natural ventilation uses differences in pressure and temperature to move air.

points.intake: The intake point is placed lower, ideally near a heating radiator. Outdoor air enters through a valve, is distributed by the indoor unit, and mixes with the warm air in the room.
points.exhaust: Warm air rises and, with sufficient draft, is exhausted through the exhaust point. Some of the accumulated moisture is removed along with it.
points.alwaysOpen: The valves can stay open around the clock. Flow intensity and direction depend on temperature, wind, and the specifics of the building. Read more in our <link>article</link>

items.question: How many valves do I need for one room?
items.answer: We recommend installing 2 valves: one for fresh air intake and one for exhaust.

items.question: Will there be a lot of dust and dirt during drilling?
items.answer: No! We use professional equipment with dust extraction. We leave the room clean after installation.

items.question: Will there be drafts?
items.answer: With correct installation and valve placement, the risk of drafts is minimal. The valve design lets you adjust the airflow.

items.question: What about heat loss?
items.answer: Near the valve the temperature may be 1–2 °C lower. With the right ventilation setup, heat loss can be minimized, but it cannot be eliminated entirely.

items.question: Does ventilation help with mold?
items.answer: Yes! Proper ventilation removes excess moisture, reduces condensation, and helps prevent mold. Existing mold must be removed separately.

items.question: Do the valves require maintenance?
items.answer: Maintenance is minimal — just clean the filter periodically. If needed, replacing a valve costs about 250–300 lei.

items.question: Can I get a price without a site visit?
items.answer: Yes! We can give you an exact quote over the phone if we know the wall material and thickness.

items.question: How do I get a discount on mold treatment?
items.answer: Install 2 ventilation valves in one room and get 50% off professional ozone treatment of the room!
